observations.behavior: The recordMessageFailure method, previously returning void, now returns a boolean. The return value is false when CDP_DLQ_ENABLED is false, and true after pushing the failure record. The comment was also updated to document this return behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could allow callers of recordMessageFailure to distinguish between a message that was retained and one that was not retained, rather than relying on the absence of a return value or a global state check. This could support better failure handling or cleanup in the CDP dead-letter queue workflow.
